name: Personal: Candidate Pipeline (Solo Recruiter)
description: Solo-operator starter: when a candidate applies, enrich their profile from public sources, score them against your role requirements, and get a Slack/Email digest — outreach drafts always wait for your approval. Built for Personal Edition (BYOK or fully local).
author: Atom

inputs.name: role_requirements
inputs.label: Role requirements
inputs.description: Plain-language must-haves for the role, e.g. '5y Python, fintech background, remote EU'.
inputs.example_value: Senior backend engineer: Python/FastAPI, Postgres, prior startup experience

inputs.name: notify_channel
inputs.label: Notify via
inputs.description: Where to send the daily digest.

steps.name: Watch for new applications
steps.description: Trigger on new application/email containing a resume or profile link.

steps.name: Enrich public profile
steps.description: Collect public professional info (site, open source, publications) relevant to the role requirements.

steps.name: Score against requirements
steps.description: Score fit 0-100 against the role requirements with cited evidence for each criterion.

steps.name: Log to pipeline tracker
steps.description: Append candidate, score, and evidence summary to your tracking sheet/notion database.

steps.name: Daily digest
steps.description: One message summarizing new candidates ranked by score.

steps.name: Outreach needs your OK (HITL)
steps.description: For candidates above your score bar, draft outreach messages — held at an approval gate. You edit/approve; nothing reaches a candidate unreviewed.

prerequisites: Gmail connected (applications arrive by email) and Slack or email for digest
